CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 30

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 22
   D. 88

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 120
   C. 46
   D. 30

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 15

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

9. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 100
   D. 50

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

11. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 4

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

19. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 17
   C. 34
   D. 66

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 21
   C. 90
   D. 30

22. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 4

23. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

24. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
